violations.text: The back ware washing area does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. Establishment is to install hand sink in the back ware washing area. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The door to the outside, located in the main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 08/10/2026

-The walls behind the 3-bay sink are constructed of wood. This material is not durable. -The ceiling in the back ware washing area was observed in poor repair with a leak and constructed of wood. Materials for wall/ceiling surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 09/06/2026

The following areas have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. -The back storage room -The walk-in cooler floors -Under the walk-in cooler shelves The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the back storage area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back storage area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2025

A hose is connected to the faucet at the service/mop sink. This faucet is lacking a backflow prevention device. An approved backflow prevention device is required in order to prevent backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply at each point of use at a food establishment. Employee removed hose at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2025
The floors in the front area of store was observed with cracks and holes. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2025
